purpose: Search for atlas-compatible additional first-integral candidates on the qualified WP2-MULTIQ-v1 model in a shared chart-local degree-three polynomial library, after exact removal of the two Xi constraint ideals and represented angular-momentum module.
evidence_boundary: A no-candidate result states only that the backend-guarded lower bound on the smallest generalized combined-constraint/value singular value exceeds the frozen training threshold in the shared chart-local, body-permutation-symmetric, combined-degree-three-or-less polynomial library over the 16 non-time canonical two-spinor variables and the fixed-energy and symmetric-mass parameters. The combined constraint requires vanishing fictitious-time Lie derivative in all three WP2-MULTIQ-v1 charts, invariance under both independent gauge circles, and equal values on collision-free chart overlaps, after coefficient-exact removal of the complete represented degree-three Xi1/Xi2 ideal and angular-momentum parameter module. The result excludes chart-asymmetric expressions, higher-degree or nonpolynomial functions, parameter-only constants, nonzero-Xi magnetic dynamics, simultaneous or triple collision, unrepresented known-integral modules, and every general no-integral or non-integrability claim. Development and calibration sources have been examined in earlier campaigns, so this is a locked model-rebaseline search rather than fresh blind confirmation. Candidate interpretation is prohibited until the staged publication gate passes and a candidate-specific resolution specification is frozen.

staged_policy.SEARCH_READY: Requires exact verification of all three prerequisite qualifications, source hashes, an intact sealed reserve, the pre-search implementation lock, rank-52 exact known-module removal, all three charts, both gauge generators, overlap constraints, and passing known controls.
staged_policy.PUBLICATION_GATE: Must be evaluated before any candidate expression or invariant interpretation. It verifies search readiness, spectral partition consistency, reserve status, and the model/claim boundary.
staged_policy.NULL_RESULT_READY: Requires the backend-guarded lower bound on the smallest generalized combined-constraint/value singular value to exceed the candidate threshold. The conclusion is only a bounded null in the frozen shared symmetric library.
staged_policy.CANDIDATE_READY: A training-eligible singular subspace blocks both a null and interpretation until a candidate-specific direction or invariant-subspace test is frozen using development and calibration data.
staged_policy.SEALED_QUALIFICATION: Can be triggered only after candidate-specific resolution is frozen under a new lock; only then may the 24-case reserve be opened once.
staged_policy.WP4_READY: Can be triggered only by a passing candidate-specific sealed qualification and independent replication on the exact WP2-MULTIQ-v1 model.
